workflow_metadata.name: Reflow Feature Update Workflow (Self-Sharpening Auto-Trigger)
workflow_metadata.description: Feature update workflow specifically for Reflow itself - automatically triggers meta-analysis after feature implementation to ensure continuous self-improvement
workflow_metadata.purpose: Update Reflow's own workflows, tools, or templates, then automatically validate changes through meta-analysis
workflow_metadata.key_innovation: Automatically triggers meta-analysis (steps META-04, META-05, META-05B) after feature update completes, creating a continuous self-sharpening loop
workflow_metadata.when_to_use: When updating Reflow's own implementation (workflows/*.json, tools/*.py, schemas/*.json, templates/*.json)
workflow_metadata.do_not_use_for: Updating OTHER systems - use standard feature_update.json workflow instead
workflow_metadata.trigger_command: Implement workflow in /path/to/reflow/workflows/98-reflow_feature_update.json on system /path/to/reflow with feature: <description>

required_conditions: Reflow repository exists and is accessible
All Reflow workflows, tools, and templates present
prerequisites.special_note: This workflow operates on Reflow itself (system_root = reflow_root)

standard.description: Standard Reflow feature update with auto meta-analysis

workflow_steps.name: Setup Reflow Feature Update
workflow_steps.description: Configure working_memory.json for Reflow self-update mode

actions.purpose: Track what's being changed for meta-analysis impact assessment

workflow_steps.name: Execute Standard Feature Update Workflow
workflow_steps.description: Run standard feature_update.json workflow steps (FU-01 through FU-05)

actions.description: Execute FU-01: Change Proposal & Impact Analysis
Execute FU-01A: Functional Architecture Analysis, Visualization & Stakeholder Validation
Execute FU-02: Functional Allocation & System Architecture Re-Engineering
actions.note: Allocates new functions to Reflow components (workflows, tools, etc.)
This step actually edits workflows/*.json, tools/*.py, schemas/*.json

actions.description: Execute FU-05: Integration, Validation & Release Preparation

outputs: Updated Reflow implementation files (workflows, tools, schemas)

gates.name: Feature Implementation Complete
checks: All feature_update.json steps (FU-01 through FU-05) completed successfully

workflow_steps.name: Auto-Trigger Meta-Analysis: Run Functional Architecture Analysis
workflow_steps.description: Automatically run meta-analysis to validate that the feature update didn't introduce context bottlenecks, gaps, or architectural issues
workflow_steps.rationale: CRITICAL: Every Reflow feature update must be validated through meta-analysis to ensure self-sharpening discipline

actions.purpose: Detect if feature update introduced issues
analyses_performed: Context path analysis (did feature add context bottlenecks?)
Cycle detection (did feature introduce unintentional circular dependencies?)
Flow efficiency analysis (is new feature well-integrated?)

focus_on: NEW bottleneck paths introduced by feature
NEW unreachable functions introduced by feature
Context consumption delta (before vs after feature)

severity_levels.CRITICAL: Feature introduced context bottlenecks or broke existing flows - MUST FIX
severity_levels.WARNING: Feature approaching limits or has inefficiencies - SHOULD FIX

outputs: Console output with feature impact summary

workflow_steps.name: Auto-Trigger Meta-Analysis: Refine Functional Architecture (if needed)
workflow_steps.description: If analysis found critical issues with the feature, refine the functional architecture spec
workflow_steps.conditional: Only if CRITICAL or WARNING issues found in RFU-03

actions.description: Review critical and warning issues introduced by feature
focus_on: Context bottlenecks introduced by new feature
Unintentional cycles created by feature integration

actions.description: Refine functional architecture to address issues

common_fixes.context_bottlenecks: Note need for lazy loading or context refresh in feature implementation
common_fixes.unreachable_functions: Add missing dependencies to connect new feature functions

actions.loop_condition: If critical issues remain, return to RFU-04-A02

workflow_steps.typical_time: 30-60 minutes if issues found, 0 minutes if no issues

gates.name: Critical Issues Resolved in Spec
checks: No critical architectural issues in functional architecture spec
Warnings documented for implementation fix in RFU-05

workflow_steps.name: Auto-Trigger Meta-Analysis: Implementation Refinement (Self-Sharpening)
workflow_steps.description: CRITICAL STEP: Fix actual implementation (workflows, tools, schemas) based on analysis results - this is the self-sharpening mechanism
workflow_steps.rationale: Feature may have introduced context bottlenecks or inefficiencies. Fix the actual code to optimize the feature.

actions.description: Map feature-introduced issues to implementation files
actions.purpose: Identify which files need to be edited to optimize the new feature

context_bottlenecks_in_new_feature: workflows/*.json - Add context refresh points in new feature workflow steps
tools/*.py - Refactor new tool functions to use lazy loading or streaming
high_context_new_functions: tools/*.py - Optimize new functions to reduce context consumption
workflows/*.json - Split high-context new workflow steps into smaller steps
unreachable_new_functions: workflows/*.json - Add missing workflow steps to create execution path for new feature

actions.output: List of files to edit with specific optimizations needed

actions.for_each_issue: Edit workflow definitions to optimize new feature
examples: Add context refresh point in new feature workflow
Split high-context new steps into multiple smaller steps
Add missing steps for unreachable new functions
actions.validation: Validate workflow JSON schema after edits

actions.description: Validate all workflow files for schema compliance (NEW v3.14.4)
actions.purpose: Catch workflow schema errors immediately after editing - prevents broken workflows from being deployed
validation_checks: All workflow files are valid JSON
next_step references point to valid steps
Tool references point to existing tools
Template references point to existing templates
actions.on_failure: FIX ERRORS NOW before proceeding - report which workflows have schema violations
actions.benefit: Prevents deployment of malformed workflows that would break Reflow
actions.note: Runs on ALL workflows in workflows/ directory, not just modified ones

examples: Refactor new tool to use lazy loading instead of loading all data
Stream large outputs instead of loading into memory

tests: Run updated workflows with new feature to verify functionality
Run optimized tools to verify outputs
Integration test: Verify new feature works end-to-end
Regression test: Verify existing functionality still works
actions.success_criteria: All tests pass, new feature optimized

actions.update: Context consumption estimates for new feature functions based on actual optimized code

actions.purpose: Verify that implementation optimizations resolved issues
actions.loop_condition: If critical issues remain, return to RFU-05-A02
actions.termination: Analysis shows no critical issues, feature optimized

workflow_steps.typical_time: 1-2 hours if optimizations needed, 0 minutes if feature already optimal

gates.name: Implementation Validated (Self-Sharpening Complete)
checks: All workflows/*.json files valid and executable
Workflow schema validation PASSED (RFU-05-A02B) - no schema violations detected
All tools/*.py files pass syntax check
Functional architecture analysis shows no critical issues from new feature
Context consumption optimized for new feature
gates.success_message: New feature implemented AND optimized - Reflow has sharpened itself
gates.critical_note: Workflow validation (RFU-05-A02B) is MANDATORY - prevents broken workflows

workflow_steps.name: Commit & Document Reflow Feature Update
workflow_steps.description: Commit all changes (feature implementation + meta-analysis optimizations) and document in meta-analysis report

actions.description: Create git commit for feature update
actions.commit_message_template:
feat(vX.Y.Z): <feature description>

Implementation:
- <implementation changes>

Self-Sharpening Optimizations (META-05B):
- <optimizations applied>

Meta-Analysis Results:
- <analysis summary>

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

actions.add_entry: Document new feature and any self-sharpening optimizations applied

required: IMPLEMENTATION OPTIMIZATIONS APPLIED (RFU-05): Feature code optimized based on analysis
Changes committed and pushed to GitHub (RFU-06)
optional: Meta-analysis report created documenting feature impact and optimizations

success_criteria.feature_complete: New feature implemented and working correctly
success_criteria.self_sharpening_complete: Feature optimized through meta-analysis - no new context bottlenecks or architectural issues
success_criteria.reflow_improved: Reflow is better than before - feature adds value AND implementation is optimized
success_criteria.continuous_loop: Automatic meta-analysis ensures every Reflow update triggers self-sharpening

comparison_to_standard_workflows.feature_update.json: Standard feature update for OTHER systems - no meta-analysis
comparison_to_standard_workflows.99-meta_analysis.json: Full meta-analysis of Reflow - manual trigger, comprehensive (6-10 hours)
comparison_to_standard_workflows.98-reflow_feature_update.json: Feature update for REFLOW ITSELF - auto-triggers targeted meta-analysis (just the new feature impact), faster (2-8 hours total)

critical_reminders: This workflow operates on Reflow itself - system_root = reflow_root
ALWAYS run steps RFU-03 through RFU-05 - meta-analysis is NOT optional for Reflow updates
RFU-05 (Implementation Refinement) is the self-sharpening step - do NOT skip
Focus meta-analysis on NEW feature impact (context delta, new functions, integration)
If feature introduces NO issues in analysis, RFU-04 and RFU-05 complete quickly (no work needed)
Commit message should document BOTH feature implementation AND self-sharpening optimizations

when_to_use_this_vs_99_meta_analysis.use_98_reflow_feature_update: When adding/updating a specific feature to Reflow (targeted analysis)
when_to_use_this_vs_99_meta_analysis.use_99_meta_analysis: When doing comprehensive health check of ALL of Reflow (quarterly, before releases)
